title.value: Negotiate retention discounts on bills by phone

introduction.value: A voice agent calls service providers, navigates IVR menus, waits on hold and negotiates retention discounts for users, pausing for OTP verification.

method.value: Kudos built a voice agent that phones a service provider for the user, works through IVR menus, waits on hold, and asks for a retention discount. By default it negotiates within the existing plan and only changes plans if the user says they're open to it. When a provider requires an OTP, the agent pauses and the user enters the code.

outcome.value: The co-founder saved $840 a year on T-Mobile after allowing plan changes, and an Xfinity example cut $276 a year. Savings vary and aren't guaranteed; many results are only loyalty discounts.

notes.value: Tell the agent up front that you're open to plan changes; without that it only negotiates the existing plan, and be present to read out the OTP when asked.

introduction.en: Kudos describes a dedicated voice agent for negotiating recurring service bills.
introduction.zh: Kudos 描述了专门用于持续性服务账单议价的语音 agent。

method.en: Kudos’ voice system calls a provider, navigates IVR, waits on hold and requests retention discounts. The source identifies it as a custom or unnamed agent.
method.zh: Kudos语音系统致电服务商、经过IVR菜单、等待接听并要求留客优惠；源站实际标签为自建或未命名agent。

method.en: It normally negotiates the current plan. Users must opt into plan changes, and the system pauses for the person to supply a required one-time verification code.
method.zh: 默认只协商现有套餐；用户须明确允许换套餐，遇一次性验证码时暂停，等待本人参与。

outcome.en: A cofounder reported $840 annual savings on T-Mobile after allowing a plan change; an Xfinity example reported $276 annually. These are examples, not guaranteed or already-paid amounts.
outcome.zh: 共同创办人允许换套餐后声称T-Mobile年省840美元，另一Xfinity示例年省276美元；属于个例，不是保证或已经到账金额。

notes.en: Many outcomes may be loyalty discounts. State plan-change preferences beforehand and remain available for verification; the suggested Manus prompt is separate from the actual voice implementation.
notes.zh: 许多结果可能仅是忠诚优惠；应预先说明换套餐意愿并在场配合验证，模板推荐Manus与实际语音实现分开记录。

Negotiate retention discounts on bills by phone
A voice agent calls service providers, navigates IVR menus, waits on hold and negotiates retention discounts for users, pausing for OTP verification.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
Kudos built a voice agent that phones a service provider for the user, works through IVR menus, waits on hold, and asks for a retention discount. By default it negotiates within the existing plan and only changes plans if the user says they're open to it. When a provider requires an OTP, the agent pauses and the user enters the code.
How it went
The co-founder saved $840 a year on T-Mobile after allowing plan changes, and an Xfinity example cut $276 a year. Savings vary and aren't guaranteed; many results are only loyalty discounts.
Worth knowing
Tell the agent up front that you're open to plan changes; without that it only negotiates the existing plan, and be present to read out the OTP when asked.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
Help me lower my [provider, e.g. internet/phone] bill, currently [amount] per month on account [account reference]. Research current competitor offers and prepare a retention-call script with my target price of [amount]. Do not call or submit anything until you've shown me the script and I approve, and pause whenever the provider needs a verification code.
